name: How much does it cost to repair a bathroom faucet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to repair a bathroom faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a bathroom faucet varies depending on the type of faucet, the extent of the damage, and the specific parts needed. Minor repairs, such as replacing a washer or O-ring, are typically less expensive than repairs requiring new cartridges or valve components. For an accurate estimate, CG Plumbing Solutions provides upfront pricing after diagnosing the issue. This transparency ensures you understand the full cost before any work begins, avoiding surprises. We serve clients across Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Henderson, and Summerlin.
